expects.query:
Deploy AMC on {{platform}}, using the `/vss-generate-video-calibration` skill end-to-end and autonomously.

**Environment & prerequisites:** A GPU host matching `{{platform}}` with Docker + NVIDIA container toolkit + `NGC_CLI_API_KEY`. The `/vss-generate-video-calibration` skill handles both deployment (`references/deploy-auto-calibration-service.md`) and calibration (`references/{videos,rtsp,sample-dataset}.md`) and runs the AMC platform preflight before deploy/capture/upload/calibration work. Deploy expects in this spec bring up `vss-auto-calibration` (MS, host-published on `${VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_HOST_PORT:-8010}`) and `vss-auto-calibration-ui` (UI on `${VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_UI_HOST_PORT:-5000}`) from the `vss-core` namespace on `nvcr.io` (org per the auto-calibration compose files); calibration expects then run against that running stack. AMC uses the `warehouse-operations` env layers: checked-in stable `.env`, checked-in `overrides.env` template, and active `generated.env`. Standalone AMC selects `COMPOSE_PROFILES=vss-auto-calibration,vss-auto-calibration-ui`; warehouse RTSP calibration sets `BP_PROFILE=bp_wh_auto_calib`, chooses `MODE`, and selects the matching `COMPOSE_PROFILES_WH_AUTO_CALIB_*` list. Project state mounts from `$VSS_APPS_DIR/services/auto-calibration/projects`; optional VGGT model mounts from `$VSS_DATA_DIR/auto-calib/vggt`. For RTSP-mode expects, the warehouse auto-calibration service list includes VIOS, so it responds at `http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/sensor/list` and `VIOS_BASE_URL` is auto-wired. For videos-mode expects, the test fixture provides `cam_00.mp4` … `cam_03.mp4` under `${VIDEO_DIR}` (defaults to `/data/videos/`) plus `alignment_data.json`, `layout.png`, and `GT.zip` under `/data/alignment/`. For sample-dataset-mode expects, `sdg_08_2_sample_data_010926.zip` is present at `assets/`.
checks: The skill loaded `references/deploy-auto-calibration-service.md` (the `deploy` mode), ran Step 0 platform preflight before NGC/image/compose work, and would stop to ask for existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host if the preflight failed
`grep -q '^COMPOSE_PROFILES=vss-auto-calibration,vss-auto-calibration-ui$' $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env` returns exit 0
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:$(grep ^VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_HOST_PORT $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env | cut -d= -f2)/v1/ready` returns exit 0

`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:$(grep ^VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_HOST_PORT $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env | cut -d= -f2)/v1/ready` body matches `"code":0`

`curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 15 http://localhost:$(grep ^VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_UI_HOST_PORT $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env | cut -d= -f2)/` returns 200
`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx vss-auto-calibration` returns exit 0
`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx vss-auto-calibration-ui` returns exit 0
`docker inspect --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}' vss-auto-calibration` returns `healthy`

expects.query: Plan only; do not run commands, start containers, call AMC APIs, download data, or modify files. The user asks to launch AMC if needed and run the bundled sample calibration test. The automated check does not provide the sample zip, so describe the exact end-to-end sample workflow and prerequisites without claiming the zip exists. Include: use the AMC sample-dataset workflow; check whether AMC is already ready; use the deploy workflow only if AMC is not ready, while still running the AMC platform preflight before sample upload/calibration; if preflight fails, stop and request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host; require sample zip at assets/sdg_08_2_sample_data_010926.zip; extract idempotently into assets/.cache/sdg_08_2_sample_data_010926/; confirm GET /v1/ready returns code == 0 before uploads; upload exactly four sorted cam_*.mp4 files, then alignment_data.json, then layout.png, then GT.zip before project verification; verify project_state == READY before calibration; start calibration with detector_type resnet for the sample; poll get_project_info until project_state == COMPLETED; fetch evaluation_statistics; and say the final report after execution will include project_id, UI URL, and sample metrics. Do not write helper scripts into the repo and do not print secrets.
checks: The plan uses the AMC sample-dataset workflow, checks whether AMC is already ready, and uses the deploy workflow only when deployment is needed while still including the shared platform preflight and failure path.
The plan requires the sample zip or an explicitly obtained sample zip before the sample run and extracts it idempotently before upload.
The plan confirms /v1/ready returns code == 0 before uploads, then uploads four sorted cam_*.mp4 files plus alignment_data.json, layout.png, and GT.zip before project verification.

The plan verifies project_state == READY before calibration, starts sample calibration with detector_type=resnet, polls until COMPLETED, and fetches evaluation statistics when the workflow is executed.
The plan says the final report after execution includes project ID, UI URL, and sample metrics, and does not print bearer tokens, NGC keys, HuggingFace tokens, or other secret values.

expects.query: Plan only; do not run commands, start containers, call AMC APIs, capture video, or modify files. The user has three RTSP streams and wants to calibrate them with AMC first. Return a detailed ordered RTSP calibration plan. Include: use the AMC RTSP workflow in `references/rtsp.md` through `vss-generate-video-calibration`; run the AMC platform preflight before VIOS probing, capture, upload, or calibration; if preflight fails, stop and request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host; only after preflight passes, check VIOS availability and `VIOS_BASE_URL`, and route to `vss-manage-video-io-storage` only if VIOS must be brought up or repaired; preserve the ordered RTSP stream list; create the AMC project; call `POST /v1/rtsp/capture/<project_id>` with the requested duration; poll the capture session until `COMPLETED`; ingest captured clips only after capture completion; upload or verify `alignment_data.json` and `layout.png`; verify `project_state == READY`; start calibration; poll until `COMPLETED`; and preserve AMC error output on failure.
checks: The plan uses the AMC RTSP calibration workflow through vss-generate-video-calibration, not the local-video or sample workflow.

The plan includes the AMC platform preflight before VIOS probing, capture, upload, or calibration work and says preflight failure stops the flow to request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host.
The plan checks VIOS availability and VIOS_BASE_URL before capture and routes to vss-manage-video-io-storage only if VIOS needs to be brought up or repaired.

The plan preserves the ordered RTSP stream list, captures clips before ingesting them, uploads/verifies alignment and layout assets, verifies project_state == READY, starts calibration, polls until COMPLETED, and preserves AMC error output on failure.
